symbol.content: def describe_corpus(repo: Path) -> Dict[str, object]:     """Count tracked files and code files so throughput has a denominator.     Falls back to a filesystem walk outside a git repository — the engine     indexes trees, not just checkouts, and a benchmark that only runs on git     repos cannot measure the case it is most often asked about.     """     try:         out = subprocess.run(             ["git", "ls-files"], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120         )         files = [f for f in out.stdout.splitlines() if f] if out.returncode == 0 else []     except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):         files = []     if not files:         files = [             str(p.relative_to(repo))             for p in repo.rglob("*")             if p.is_file() and ".git" not in p.parts         ]     code = [f for f in files if Path(f).suffix.lower() in _CODE_SUFFIXES]     total_bytes = 0     for rel in code:         try:             total_bytes += (repo / rel).stat().st_size         except OSError:             pass     return {         "tracked_files": len(files),         "code_files": len(code),         "code_bytes": total_bytes,     }
